infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GymDate requires camera access to scan QR passes at gym locations and take profile photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GymDate requires location access to discover nearby gyms and workout partners near you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GymDate requires location access to discover nearby gyms and workout partners near you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GymDate requires access to your photo library to let you choose and upload a profile photo or gym image.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: GymDate requires permission to save gym pass QR images to your photo library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow GymDate to access your location to find nearby gyms.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow GymDate to access your location to find nearby gyms.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow GymDate to access your photo gallery to upload a profile avatar.
